title: 歌词 / Lyrics
网易云 API 地址 / NetEase API Base
description: 本地网易云 API 地址 / Local NetEase Cloud Music API base URL.

title: 全局歌词偏移 / Lyric Offset
description: 单位毫秒。正数让歌词更早显示，负数让歌词更晚显示 / In milliseconds. Positive shows later lyric lines earlier; negative delays them.

title: 听歌识曲 / Audio Match
启用听歌识曲 / Enable Audio Match
description: 开启后用当前谱面音频识别网易云歌曲并优先管理歌词加载；关闭后仅使用标题搜索 / When enabled, current beatmap audio identifies the NetEase song and prioritizes lyric loading; disabled uses title search only.

title: 识曲开始时间 / Match Start
description: 负数时自动取歌曲中点前后各 7.5 秒；非负数时从指定秒数开始取样 / Negative uses a 15s window centered on the song; non-negative starts from this second.

title: 识曲时长 / Match Duration
description: 开始时间为非负数时使用的取样秒数；开始时间为负数时固定使用 15 秒 / Sample length for non-negative Match Start; negative Match Start always uses 15s.

title: 识曲最小偏移 / Audio Match Min Offset
description: 小于此值的识曲偏移会被视为异常并回退标题搜索 / Audio-match offsets below this are rejected and metadata search is used.

title: 识曲最大偏移 / Audio Match Max Offset
description: 大于此值的识曲偏移会被视为异常并回退标题搜索 / Audio-match offsets above this are rejected and metadata search is used.

title: 不变调降速识曲（实验性） / Preserve-Pitch Match (Experimental)
description: 仅检测到谱面倍速时生效。常规变调降速识曲失败或偏移异常后，额外以保持音调的时间拉伸重试；会增加 CPU 使用和等待时间 / Only used when a speed keyword is detected. Retries with pitch-preserving time stretch after normal pitch-shift matching fails; increases CPU use and wait time.

title: 多窗口听歌识曲 / Multi-Window Audio Match
description: 先识别歌曲中点；中点结果未被标题搜索前三候选确认时，再识别 25% 和 75% 位置并进行歌曲 ID 与偏移共识判断。仅在 Match Start 为负数时生效 / Match the midpoint first. When title-search top candidates do not confirm it, also match 25% and 75% positions and use ID/offset consensus. Only applies when Match Start is negative.

title: 始终进行四路识曲 / Always Use 25% / 50% / 75% / Title
description: 开启后即使 50% 识曲结果已被标题候选确认，仍会继续识别 25% 和 75% 并计算四路可信度；会增加识曲等待时间和少量 CPU 使用 / Continue with 25% and 75% even when 50% is confirmed by title search, then calculate four-source confidence. Adds matching time and a small CPU cost.

title: 识曲偏移共识阈值 / Audio Match Offset Consensus
description: 多个窗口识别到同一歌曲时，偏移差不超过此毫秒数会被视为一致并取平均值；建议 100 到 1000 / When windows identify the same song, offsets within this many milliseconds are treated as consistent and averaged. Recommended: 100 to 1000.

title: 首句自动偏移 / First-Line Auto Offset
description: 用第一句歌词和第一个物件估算偏移，默认关闭；听歌识曲开启时不会使用它 / Estimate offset from first lyric and first object, disabled by default; ignored when Audio Match is enabled.

title: 自动偏移上限 / Auto Offset Limit
description: 自动估算偏移的最大绝对值，单位毫秒 / Maximum absolute auto offset in milliseconds.

title: 自动提前量 / Auto Offset Lead
description: 歌词普遍滞后时增大它，单位毫秒 / Extra milliseconds added when lyrics feel late.

title: 难度名自动倍速 / Auto Speed From Difficulty
description: 从难度名读取 1.2x、x1.2、1,2x、x1,2，以及独立的 1.2 / 1,2 等倍速关键词并缩放歌词时间 / Read 1.2x, x1.2, comma-decimal variants, and standalone 1.2 / 1,2 speed keywords from difficulty name.

title: 同包复用歌曲结果 / Reuse Song Within Set
description: 非 Pack/Collection/LNEX 合包时，切换难度不重复搜索；会重新计算难度倍率。

title: BPM 标签识曲 / BPM Tag Audio Match
description: 检测 [120] 一类 BPM 标签后，先按标题获取 BPM 再识曲（性能）。

title: 手动倍速 / Manual Speed Multiplier
description: 额外歌词速度倍率 / Extra lyric speed multiplier.

title: 上一行数量 / Previous Lines
description: 当前歌词前显示多少行 / How many previous lyric lines to show.

title: 下一行数量 / Next Lines
description: 当前歌词后显示多少行 / How many next lyric lines to show.

title: 显示翻译 / Show Translation
description: 网易云返回翻译歌词时显示翻译 / Show translated lyrics when available.

title: 歌曲信息格式 / Song Header Format
description: two-line 分两行显示歌名和歌手；single-line 在一行显示“歌名 / 歌手” / two-line shows title and artist separately; single-line shows “Title / Artist” on one line.

title: 显示识曲状态 / Show Audio Match Status
description: 在右上角偏移值左侧显示听歌识曲成功、失败、识别中或关闭状态 / Show audio-match success, failure, matching, or disabled state left of the offset badge.

title: 显示调试信息 / Show Debug Status
description: 显示面板底部的网络、识曲窗口、MV 来源及错误信息；关闭时仅隐藏显示，不影响功能 / Show network, audio-match window, MV source, and error details at the bottom of the panel. Hiding it does not affect functionality.

title: 歌词切换动画 / Lyric Transition
description: fade 为淡入淡出，roll 为滚动过渡，off 为关闭动画 / fade crossfades, roll slides lines between positions, off disables animation.

title: 逐字进度高亮 / Lyric Progress Highlight
description: 当前句中已唱部分使用亮色，未唱部分稍暗；优先读取 /lyric/new 返回的 YRC 词级时间，YRC 不可用时按句间时间平滑推进 / Brighten sung text and dim upcoming text. Prefer word-timed YRC from /lyric/new; otherwise progress smoothly between line timestamps.

title: 未唱歌词亮度 / Upcoming Lyric Brightness
description: 范围 0.12 到 0.9，数值越小未唱部分越暗 / Range 0.12 to 0.9. Lower is dimmer.

title: 字体 / Font
启用自定义字体 / Enable Custom Font
description: 启用后从下方路径载入 TTF 字体；失败时自动使用系统字体 / Load a TTF font from the path below; falls back to system fonts on failure.

title: 自定义 TTF 路径 / Custom TTF Path
description: 相对于插件 index.html 的路径，例如 fonts/MyFont.ttf；请将字体文件放在插件目录内 / Path relative to index.html, e.g. fonts/MyFont.ttf. Put the font file inside this plugin folder.

title: 字号倍率 / Font Scale
description: 所有默认值为 1，范围建议为 0.5 到 3 / All default to 1; recommended range is 0.5 to 3.

title: 标题字号倍率 / Title Font Scale
description: 歌曲标题的字号倍率 / Font scale for the song title.

title: 作者字号倍率 / Artist Font Scale
description: 艺术家名称的字号倍率 / Font scale for the artist name.

title: 当前歌词字号倍率 / Current Lyric Font Scale
description: 当前歌词的字号倍率 / Font scale for the current lyric.

title: 前后歌词字号倍率 / Context Lyric Font Scale
description: 当前歌词前后行的字号倍率 / Font scale for previous and next lyrics.

title: 翻译字号倍率 / Translation Font Scale
description: 翻译歌词的字号倍率 / Font scale for translated lyrics.

title: 偏移字号倍率 / Offset Font Scale
description: 右上角偏移值的字号倍率 / Font scale for the top-right offset value.

title: 歌词时间字号倍率 / Lyric Time Font Scale
description: 歌词时间读数的字号倍率 / Font scale for the lyric timestamp.

title: 调试信息字号倍率 / Debug Font Scale
description: 底部状态与调试信息的字号倍率 / Font scale for bottom status and debug text.

title: 搜索候选数 / Search Limit
description: 标题搜索时检查多少个网易云候选 / How many NetEase candidates to inspect.

title: 缓存文件路径 / Song Cache Path
description: 可编辑歌曲 ID 缓存 JSON 路径 / Editable song id cache JSON path.

title: 缓存写入器 / Song Cache Writer
description: 可选本地写入器地址；启动 cache-writer.js 后填 http://127.0.0.1:3001/song-cache / Optional local writer endpoint.

title: 布局 / Layout
面板宽度 / Overlay Width
description: 面板宽度，单位像素 / Panel width in pixels.

title: 歌词高度 / Lyrics Height
description: 歌词区域固定高度，单位像素 / Fixed lyric viewport height in pixels.

title: 主题 / Theme
面板颜色模式 / Panel Color Mode
description: manual 使用手动颜色；beatmap 从背景取色 / manual uses Panel Color; beatmap samples background.

title: 面板颜色 / Panel Color
description: 备用或手动面板颜色 / Fallback or manual panel color.

title: 面板透明度 / Panel Opacity
description: 范围 0 到 1 / Range 0 to 1.

title: 背景混合强度 / Beatmap Color Blend
description: 背景取色后向面板色混合；越高越暗更稳定 / Higher is darker and steadier.

title: 背景强调色 / Accent From Beatmap
description: 用背景取色更新翻译和进度条颜色 / Use sampled background color for accent and progress bar.

title: MV 背景 / MV Background
启用 MV 背景 / Enable MV Background
description: 识别或搜索确定网易云歌曲后，若该歌曲存在 MV，则在歌词面板底层播放；无 MV 时保留原有面板背景 / After a NetEase song is resolved, play its MV behind the lyric panel when available; keep the existing background when unavailable.

title: MV 最大分辨率 / MV Max Resolution
description: 请求 MV 播放地址时使用的最大分辨率，建议 480、720 或 1080；较低分辨率可减少网络和显存占用 / Maximum requested MV resolution. Use 480, 720, or 1080; lower values use less bandwidth and video memory.

title: MV 歌词遮罩透明度 / MV Lyric Overlay Opacity
description: MV 播放时歌词面板深色遮罩的不透明度，范围 0.15 到 0.95；数值越高歌词越清晰 / Dark lyric-panel overlay opacity while an MV plays. Range 0.15 to 0.95; higher values improve readability.

title: MV 背景亮度 / MV Background Brightness
description: 仅在 MV 背景播放时应用，范围 0.25 到 1.4；1 为原始亮度，较低数值可提高歌词可读性 / Applied only while an MV background plays. Range 0.25 to 1.4; 1 is the original brightness and lower values improve lyric readability.

title: MV 背景透明度 / MV Background Opacity
description: 仅在 MV 背景播放时应用，范围 0.1 到 1；数值越低视频越透明，面板底色越明显 / Applied only while an MV background plays. Range 0.1 to 1; lower values make the video more transparent.

title: MV 居中裁切宽度 / MV Center Crop Width
description: 保留的画面宽度比例，范围 0.5 到 1；1 为不裁切，较低数值会居中裁掉更多左右内容 / Visible width ratio. Range 0.5 to 1; 1 keeps full width and lower values crop more from both sides.

title: MV 居中裁切高度 / MV Center Crop Height
description: 保留的画面高度比例，范围 0.5 到 1；1 为不裁切，较低数值会居中裁掉更多上下内容 / Visible height ratio. Range 0.5 to 1; 1 keeps full height and lower values crop more from top and bottom.

title: Bilibili 视频背景 / Bilibili Video Background
description: 仅在已启用 MV 背景且网易云没有对应 MV 时使用 / Used only when MV Background is enabled and NetEase has no MV.

title: 启用 Bilibili 视频回退 / Enable Bilibili Video Fallback
description: 网易云歌曲没有 MV 时，搜索 Bilibili 的第一条视频；仅在时长接近时作为背景播放 / When the NetEase song has no MV, search Bilibili's first video result and use it only when duration is close.

title: MV 背景来源优先级 / MV Background Source Priority
description: 选择优先尝试的背景来源；首选来源不可用时自动回退另一来源 / Select the background source to try first. The other source is used automatically when the preferred source is unavailable.

title: Bilibili 最大时长偏差 % / Bilibili Max Duration Deviation %
description: 第一条 Bilibili 搜索结果与网易云歌曲时长允许的最大百分比差异，范围 1 到 30；较低数值更安全 / Maximum allowed duration difference between Bilibili's first result and the NetEase song. Range 1 to 30; lower is safer.

title: Bilibili 搜索不含歌手 / Bilibili Search Without Artist
description: 开启后仅以网易云歌曲名搜索 Bilibili，不附加歌手名；仍会检查第一条视频的时长偏差 / Search Bilibili with only the NetEase song title, without the artist. The first result still must pass duration validation.

title: 网络 / Network
请求超时 / Fetch Timeout
description: 网易云 API 请求超时时间，单位毫秒 / NetEase API timeout in milliseconds.

title: POST 兜底 / POST Fallback
description: GET 遇到 HTTP 404/405 时改用 POST 重试 / Retry with POST when GET returns HTTP 404/405.
